v.q: Which service suits key-based access at huge scale with single-digit millisecond latency?
v.w: DynamoDB is serverless and designed for key access at any scale. It is not for ad hoc joins.

v.q: Which service is built for relational data with up to 15 readers on shared storage?
v.w: Aurora separates compute from a shared cluster volume, so readers add quickly.

v.q: What is the purpose of RDS Multi-AZ?
v.w: A synchronous standby in another zone takes over on failure. Read replicas are for read scale.

v.q: Which is true of an RDS read replica?
o: It replicates asynchronously and can lag
v.w: Replicas lag a little, so reads that must see the latest write should use the primary.

v.q: How many copies of data does an Aurora cluster volume keep?
v.w: Six copies over three zones, self-healing, so failover needs no data copy.

v.q: Which Aurora feature gives cross-region disaster recovery in about a minute?
v.w: Global Database replicates storage to other regions in under a second and can promote a secondary.

v.q: What makes a good DynamoDB partition key?
v.w: An even spread avoids a hot partition and throttling.

v.q: How do you query a DynamoDB table by an attribute that is not the key?
v.w: A GSI gives a second key for another access pattern. Scans read everything and are costly.

v.q: Which condition makes a DynamoDB put idempotent?
v.w: A repeated request fails the condition instead of creating a duplicate.

v.q: How does the Enhanced Client give optimistic locking?
v.w: The version is checked and incremented on update, so a concurrent change is rejected.

v.q: Why use RDS Proxy with Lambda?
o: It encrypts the data at rest
v.w: Each Lambda environment would otherwise open its own connection.

v.q: Why keep a short JVM DNS TTL with RDS Multi-AZ?
o: The endpoint name moves on failover
v.w: A long DNS cache keeps pointing at the failed primary.

v.q: What is the maximum automated backup retention for RDS point-in-time recovery?
v.w: Automated backups keep up to 35 days. Manual snapshots stay until deleted.

Tick a box on the running instance
v.w: Encryption at rest is chosen at creation, so you restore from an encrypted snapshot copy.
